```{r functions}
# Define Nature theme function
theme_nature_contract <- function(base_size = 6.0, base_family = "Arial") {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.5, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size - 0.3, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.8),
      strip.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.5, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = base_size + 0.5, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
}

# Define publication saver
save_publication_figure <- function(plot, filename, width_mm = 180, height_mm = 160, dpi = 300) {
  w <- width_mm / 25.4
  h <- height_mm / 25.4

  # PNG
  ragg::agg_png(paste0(filename, ".png"), width = w, height = h, units = "in", res = dpi)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()
}
```

```{r process_technology}
# Function to process a single folder and return the line and heatmap plots
process_technology <- function(fld_path, dataset_title, tech_title, show_y_label = TRUE) {
  profile_files <- list.files(fld_path, pattern = "_profiles\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(profile_files) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No profile CSV files found in:", fld_path))
  }

  # Read and pool all profiles using data.table for speed
  pooled_list <- list()
  for (i in seq_along(profile_files)) {
    pooled_list[[i]] <- fread(profile_files[i])
  }
  pooled_dt <- rbindlist(pooled_list)

  # Filter length >= 100
  pooled_dt <- pooled_dt[length >= 100]

  if (nrow(pooled_dt) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No transcripts with length >= 100 found in:", fld_path))
  }

  # Average across samples for each transcript_id
  bin_cols <- grep("^bin_", names(pooled_dt), value = TRUE)
  sd_cols <- c("length", bin_cols)

  averaged_dt <- pooled_dt[, lapply(.SD, mean, na.rm = TRUE), by = transcript_id, .SDcols = sd_cols]
  averaged_df <- as_tibble(averaged_dt)

  # Classify into 3 groups
  averaged_df <- averaged_df %>%
    mutate(
      LengthGroup = case_when(
        length <= 3000 ~ "<= 3 kb",
        length <= 6000 ~ "3-6 kb",
        TRUE ~ "> 6 kb"
      ),
      LengthGroup = factor(LengthGroup, levels = c("<= 3 kb", "3-6 kb", "> 6 kb"))
    )

  # Calculate unique counts and create labels dynamically
  counts <- averaged_df %>%
    count(LengthGroup)

  label_map <- counts %>%
    mutate(
      Label = paste0(LengthGroup, "\n(n = ", format(n, big.mark = ","), ")")
    ) %>%
    select(LengthGroup, Label) %>%
    deframe()

  # Update factor levels in averaged_df
  averaged_df <- averaged_df %>%
    mutate(
      GroupLabel = factor(label_map[as.character(LengthGroup)],
                          levels = as.character(label_map[c("<= 3 kb", "3-6 kb", "> 6 kb")]))
    )

  # Calculate average metagene profile per length group (top panel)
  metagene_profile <- averaged_df %>%
    group_by(LengthGroup) %>%
    select(LengthGroup, starts_with("bin_")) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("bin_"),
      names_to = "Percentile",
      names_prefix = "bin_",
      values_to = "Coverage"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Percentile = as.numeric(Percentile))

  # Prepare heatmap data (bottom panel) with hierarchical clustering within each length group
  heatmap_data_list <- list()
  for (g in unique(averaged_df$GroupLabel)) {
    group_df <- averaged_df %>% filter(GroupLabel == g)
    n_g <- nrow(group_df)
    if (n_g > 1) {
      bin_cols_ordered <- paste0("bin_", 1:100)
      mat <- as.matrix(group_df[, bin_cols_ordered, drop = FALSE])
      mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0

      if (n_g <= 1500) {
        # Perform standard hierarchical clustering
        d <- dist(mat)
        hc <- hclust(d, method = "ward.D2")
        group_df <- group_df[hc$order, ]
      } else {
        # Perform fast hybrid clustering (kmeans + hclust on centers)
        set.seed(42)
        k_centers <- 1000
        km <- kmeans(mat, centers = k_centers, iter.max = 10, nstart = 1)

        # Cluster centers
        d_centers <- dist(km$centers)
        hc_centers <- hclust(d_centers, method = "ward.D2")

        # Order clusters
        cluster_order <- hc_centers$order
        group_df$Cluster <- km$cluster
        group_df$ClusterOrder <- match(group_df$Cluster, cluster_order)

        # Compute centroids for ordering within clusters
        centroids <- rowSums(mat * 1:100) / (rowSums(mat) + 1e-5)
        group_df$Centroid <- centroids

        # Arrange by cluster order and then by centroid
        group_df <- group_df %>% arrange(ClusterOrder, Centroid)
      }
    }
    group_df$RowIndex <- 1:nrow(group_df)

    heatmap_data_list[[g]] <- group_df
  }

  heatmap_matrix <- bind_rows(heatmap_data_list)

  heatmap_data <- heatmap_matrix %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("bin_"),
      names_to = "Percentile",
      names_prefix = "bin_",
      values_to = "Coverage"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Percentile = as.numeric(Percentile))

  # Build top panel plot
  p_line <- ggplot(metagene_profile, aes(x = Percentile, y = Coverage, color = LengthGroup)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.45) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 50, 100), limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1.0), limits = c(0, 1.05)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "<= 3 kb" = "#3182BD",
      "3-6 kb" = "#E28E2C",
      "> 6 kb" = "#D24B40"
    )) +
    labs(
      title = tech_title,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Mean coverage",
      color = "Transcript length"
    ) +
    theme_nature_contract() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.key.size = unit(2.5, "mm")
    )

  # Build bottom panel heatmap
  p_heatmap <- ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = Percentile, y = RowIndex, fill = Coverage)) +
    geom_raster(interpolate = TRUE) +
    facet_grid(GroupLabel ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 50, 100), limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_reverse(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = "D",
      direction = -1,
      limits = c(0, 1),
      na.value = "grey80",
      name = "Norm. cov"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Transcript percentile (5' to 3')",
      y = if (show_y_label) "Transcripts (clustered by profile)" else NULL
    ) +
    theme_nature_contract() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 4.8),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#F2F2F2", colour = NA),
      legend.key.size = unit(2.5, "mm")
    )

  if (!show_y_label) {
    p_heatmap <- p_heatmap + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())
  }

  return(list(line = p_line, heatmap = p_heatmap,
              profile = metagene_profile, counts = counts, matrix = heatmap_matrix))
}
```

```{r generate_figures}
# ── 1. GENERATE MOUSE FIGURE (Iso-Seq | Kinnex | ONT cDNA) ────────────────
res_isoseq <- process_technology(file.path(base_dir, "isoseq_nih"), "Mouse", "Iso-Seq", show_y_label = TRUE)
res_kinnex <- process_technology(file.path(base_dir, "kinnex_nih"), "Mouse", "Kinnex", show_y_label = FALSE)
res_ont    <- process_technology(file.path(base_dir, "ont_nih"), "Mouse", "ONT cDNA", show_y_label = FALSE)

res_isoseq$line <- res_isoseq$line + labs(tag = "a")
res_kinnex$line <- res_kinnex$line + labs(tag = "b")
res_ont$line    <- res_ont$line + labs(tag = "c")

col1 <- wrap_plots(res_isoseq$line, res_isoseq$heatmap, ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 3.2))
col2 <- wrap_plots(res_kinnex$line, res_kinnex$heatmap, ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 3.2))
col3 <- wrap_plots(res_ont$line, res_ont$heatmap, ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 3.2))

fig_mouse <- (col1 | col2 | col3) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", family = "Arial"))

save_publication_figure(fig_mouse, file.path(out_dir, "Supplementary_Figure_1"), width_mm = 135, height_mm = 128)
message("Saved Mouse figure.")

# ── 2. GENERATE NEURON FIGURE (Kinnex | ONT cDNA) ───────────────────────
res_kinnex_neu <- process_technology(file.path(base_dir, "kinnex_neuron"), "Neuron", "Kinnex", show_y_label = TRUE)
res_ont_neu    <- process_technology(file.path(base_dir, "ont_neuron"), "Neuron", "ONT cDNA", show_y_label = FALSE)

res_kinnex_neu$line <- res_kinnex_neu$line + labs(tag = "a")
res_ont_neu$line    <- res_ont_neu$line + labs(tag = "b")

col1_neu <- wrap_plots(res_kinnex_neu$line, res_kinnex_neu$heatmap, ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 3.2))
col2_neu <- wrap_plots(res_ont_neu$line, res_ont_neu$heatmap, ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 3.2))

fig_neuron <- (col1_neu | col2_neu) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", family = "Arial"))

save_publication_figure(fig_neuron, file.path(out_dir, "Supplementary_Figure_2"), width_mm = 120, height_mm = 128)
message("Saved Neuron figure.")

# ── 3. GENERATE LONGBENCH FIGURE (Kinnex | ONT cDNA | ONT dRNA) ─────────
res_kinnex_lb <- process_technology(file.path(base_dir, "kinnex_longbench"), "LongBench", "Kinnex", show_y_label = TRUE)
res_ont_lb    <- process_technology(file.path(base_dir, "ont_longbench"), "LongBench", "ONT cDNA", show_y_label = FALSE)
res_drna_lb   <- process_technology(file.path(base_dir, "drna_longbench"), "LongBench", "ONT dRNA", show_y_label = FALSE)

res_kinnex_lb$line <- res_kinnex_lb$line + labs(tag = "a")
res_ont_lb$line    <- res_ont_lb$line + labs(tag = "b")
res_drna_lb$line   <- res_drna_lb$line + labs(tag = "c")

col1_lb <- wrap_plots(res_kinnex_lb$line, res_kinnex_lb$heatmap, ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 3.2))
col2_lb <- wrap_plots(res_ont_lb$line, res_ont_lb$heatmap, ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 3.2))
col3_lb <- wrap_plots(res_drna_lb$line, res_drna_lb$heatmap, ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 3.2))

fig_longbench <- (col1_lb | col2_lb | col3_lb) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", family = "Arial"))

save_publication_figure(fig_longbench, file.path(out_dir, "Supplementary_Figure_3"), width_mm = 135, height_mm = 128)
message("Saved LongBench figure.")
```

```{r source_data}
source("../source_data_utils.R")

# Top panels: mean normalized coverage per length group (one row per group,
# bin_1 = 5' end, bin_100 = 3' end). Bottom heatmaps: one row per transcript
# (coverage averaged across samples) in the plotted order; these matrices are
# large, so they are written as gzipped CSVs instead of xlsx sheets.
metagene_source <- function(panels, figure) {
  profiles <- lapply(panels, function(r) {
    r$profile %>%
      mutate(Percentile = paste0("bin_", Percentile)) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = Percentile, values_from = Coverage) %>%
      left_join(r$counts, by = "LengthGroup") %>%
      select(`Length group` = LengthGroup, `Number of transcripts` = n, starts_with("bin_"))
  })
  names(profiles) <- paste(names(panels), "profile")
  write_source_data(profiles, figure)

  for (p in names(panels)) {
    out <- panels[[p]]$matrix %>%
      select(`Length group` = LengthGroup, `Row (top to bottom)` = RowIndex,
             transcript_id, length, starts_with("bin_")) %>%
      mutate(across(starts_with("bin_"), ~ round(.x, 4)))
    csv_name <- paste0("Source_Data_", figure, "_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", p), "_heatmap.csv.gz")
    data.table::fwrite(out, file.path("tables", csv_name))
  }
}

metagene_source(list(`Supp Fig 1a` = res_isoseq, `Supp Fig 1b` = res_kinnex,
                     `Supp Fig 1c` = res_ont), "Supplementary_Figure_1")
metagene_source(list(`Supp Fig 2a` = res_kinnex_neu, `Supp Fig 2b` = res_ont_neu),
                "Supplementary_Figure_2")
metagene_source(list(`Supp Fig 3a` = res_kinnex_lb, `Supp Fig 3b` = res_ont_lb,
                     `Supp Fig 3c` = res_drna_lb), "Supplementary_Figure_3")
```
